prompt_md: If the day before yesterday was Friday, what day of the week will the day after tomorrow be?
prompt_short: Day before yesterday was Friday. What day is the day after tomorrow?
hint_md: First work out what day it is today.
explain_intuition_md: Friday was two days ago, so today is Sunday. It is easy to stop at today or step only one day forward; two days on from Sunday is Tuesday.
explain_math_md: Today $=$ Friday $+ 2 =$ Sunday, and Sunday $+ 2 =$ Tuesday.
